newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Unilever Malaysia sees 8-10 pct sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Unilever Malaysia sees 8-10 pct sales growth.

text.p: Unilever Holdings (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd, part of Britain's Unilever PLC, expects revenue to grow by 8-10 percent for the financial year ending December 31, 1996, the national Bernama news agency said on Monday.

Bernama was quoting Unilever Malaysia's chairman and managing director Chim Howe Lai, who said, "We can still see spectacular results this year even though we are facing a highly competitive and challenging environment, especially in the consumer and oleochemical sectors."
Unilever Malaysia reported pre-tax profits of 44.5 million ringgit on sales of 521.5 million ringgit in 1995.
The company is a joint venture between U.K.'s Unilever plc and several Malaysian government-owned funds.
